name: effect-particles-coalesce
title: Particles Coalesce
description: Sáu mươi hạt từ khắp khung bay về các điểm trên viền một hình (trái tim, logo) theo lò xo, hơi vượt rồi đứng yên.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 60 particles (r 3) from seeded random spots over the frame to points on the target outline (heart in the demo, a logo in a film), each on a spring (stiffness 60, damping 10, small overshoot), starts spread over 0-300 ms; ~1200 ms; exit reverses in 500 ms ease-in. Params: count (60) · spring (60 / 10) · src: hình đích (SVG / PNG). The target here is a heart outline; in a film, sample the client logo's outline into points.
